description: Home advantage for a 2DT sport is RAW POINTS -- the model is additive, there is no link to undo. Applying football's exp() to an additive 4-point parameter published a home edge of 54.6 and every schema in the tree accepted it (B5). This bound rejects that shape. It is a gross-error guard, not a complete B5 detector: a real Icelandic basketball home edge is a few points, and +/-30 is deliberately generous. The exact check is tests/testthat/test-extract-2dt-home-advantage-units.R.
